Animal Crossing: New Horizons — Still Worth Buying?

Nintendo Switch · Updated 2026-08-05

Animal Crossing: New Horizons is the cozy life-sim that defined the early Switch era. You build up an island, befriend villagers, and play at your own pace — there's no fail state and no pressure.

What you get

  • An open-ended island you terraform, decorate, and populate
  • Seasonal events that track the real-world calendar
  • Local and online multiplayer (visit friends' islands)
  • The Happy Home Paradise DLC for home-design gameplay

Who it's for

Perfect for relaxed players, families, and anyone who wants a game that fits around a busy life rather than demanding hours at a time. Less so for players who need goals, combat, or a clear ending.

Should you buy the DLC?

Happy Home Paradise is available via the Nintendo Switch Online + Expansion Pack subscription, so if you already subscribe, you already own it. Buying it standalone only makes sense if you don't want the subscription.
